name: files.resolveConflict
doc: {jobId,conflictId,choice:'replace'|'skip'|'keepBoth'|'cancel'|'retry',applyToAll?:bool} → {ok,jobId,state,...}: answer the exact pending files.conflict question in this backend. Allowed choices come from that event. interactive:true opts Explorer copy/move/paste into collision and recoverable-error questions; legacy clients keep unique names. Retry is explicit and never applies to all. Cancel wakes a pending question. Replaced/merged results have undoable:false; recoveryPaths are preserved for the user.

Pause is confirmed by files.progress state:'paused'; cancellation keeps completed items and cleans only the current partial copy. An individual move commit finishes before a pending request is honoured. Dry-run validates without creating or changing jobs.

name: update.release.check
doc: {} → {started:true}: check-new-release -q on its own thread, only on a click (the page's Check for updates), at most daily (hourly after a failed run); else {started:false, skipped:'never'|'offline'|'metered'|'recent'|'running'}

name: update.release.compat
doc: {refresh?:bool} → {started:true} | {started:false, skipped:'notOffered'|'hold'|'recent'|'offline'|'metered'|'running'}: the compatibility check of the offered Ubuntu release (compat.rs; cheap verdict first: a releases.json status other than tested, or a GNOME major the installed extension's shell-version lacks, holds without running anything; else the private apt tree, at most once per release per 7 days, a failed check after 1 h or with refresh); the verdict arrives with update.changed in release.state

name: update.release.setPrompt

name: update.release.start
doc: {anyway?:bool} → {started:true, already?:true}: Ubuntu's preconditions in order (not_offered; updates_pending with data {count, held}; reboot_first; busy; hold — anyway:true only after the page's warning and only for a hold verdict whose release has allowAnyway), then upgrade.json, temporary linger and pkexec do-release-upgrade in a terminal through the wrapper (Role::App, app.slice); already:true while our start is still on its way

name: update.release.ubuntuHold
doc: {on:bool} → {on, codename}: postpone Ubuntu's own release prompt (two update-manager keys, reversible)

name: update.setAutoOpen

name: update.setWatching

name: update.status
doc: {packages?:bool} → the update snapshot {backend, phase, rev, rows, totals, job, restart, error, warnings, network, release:{state, offered, released, version, codename, name, eol, supportMonths, notesUrl, upgradeBroken, source:'cache'|'stamp'|null, prompt, promptFile, override, currentLts, helper, checkedAt, lastCheck, checkError, ubuntuPromptHeld, …}, …}; files only in every host; release (GW6, additive): state none|checking|ok|warn|hold|ubuntuHold|blocked|unknown (GW7 adds updatesFirst|rebootFirst|running|waiting|startFailed|ended), verdict (GW6's state, never overridden by GW7), reasons [{code, key, params, message}] (update.compat.*, rendered per call), gnomeMajor (the archive's major, null when only releases.json gave one), allowAnyway (releases.json, per codename), compat {running, needed, checkedAt} (needed: the page asks update.release.compat), upgraderNl (ubuntu-release-upgrader has a Dutch catalogue); release (GW7, additive): state is the card (running, waiting, startFailed, ended, updatesFirst, rebootFirst, none after an upgrade that waits for its reboot, else the verdict), verdict (GW6's state under it), startRc, reasons (startFailed: the start failure), verdictReasons, heldNames, attachable

name: winpoint.cancel
doc: {jobId} → {ok:true}: stop the owner's running job before its installer starts (downloading, verifying, unpacking, preparing; it ends cancelled, its partial download deleted); error cannot_cancel once installing, no_job for any other id; forwarded like winpoint.check; dry run {ok:true, dryRun:true}

name: winpoint.check
doc: {} → {started:true} | {started:false, skipped:'running'|'recent'|'rateLimited'|'offline', retryAfter?}: ask GitHub for WinPoint's newest stable release now (D-G74a; only the owner, win11-shell's backend, contacts GitHub: other hosts forward it as winpoint.request and get its winpoint.reply within 3 s, else error noOwner; recent = within 30 s; offline = NetworkManager connectivity none, recorded as the last result; ignores the daily schedule and update.winpointAutoCheck, not GitHub's retryAfter); a check never downloads or installs; dry run {started:false, dryRun:true}; a failed WIN11_WINPOINT_TEST seam: error test_seam; event winpoint.changed {rev} when the check starts and when it ends

name: winpoint.install
doc: {version, metered?:bool} → {jobId}: the user's Download and install or Try again (D-G74; the only way the updater starts the release bundle's scripts/install.py, never a check, timer or notification); forwarded to the owner like winpoint.check (noOwner after 3 s); refused in this order: dev {path} (not an installed run), stale (version is not the release offered now), noAsset, noDigest (GitHub gave no digest for its tarball), incompatible|manual|missingParts (install.py --check's verdict for that version, data {detail}), noPython, offline, metered (data {size}; again with metered:true after the page's confirmation, or with update.metered on), busy (a job, Ubuntu's upgrader, an update or Software job, a shell.restartAll under way), space {size, path}; the job then asks GitHub again (that answer's URL, size and digest), downloads the .sha256 and the tarball (both must match GitHub's digest), unpacks, runs install.py --check and the install; events winpoint.changed {rev} on every state and winpoint.progress {jobId, state, done, total} at most once a second; dry run {jobId:null, dryRun:true}

name: winpoint.status
doc: {} → {mode:'installed'|'dev'|'dry'|'unsupported', ownerRunning, version, installed, current, arch, autoCheck, state:'unsupported'|'checkFailed'|'downloading'|'verifying'|'unpacking'|'preparing'|'installing'|'installed'|'interrupted'|'failed'|'checking'|'offline'|'rateLimited'|'unreachable'|'available'|'upToDate'|'unknown' (in this order of precedence), result, checkedAt, okAt, nextCheckAt, retryAfter, latest:{version, tag, name, publishedAt, notesUrl, asset, size, reason:'noAsset'|'dev'|'noDigest'|'noPython'|'incompatible'|'manual'|'missingParts'|null, params, message, detail, canInstall}|null, job:{jobId, version, state, done, total, startedAt, finishedAt, restart:'restart'|'relogin'|null, outcome:'nothingChanged'|'rolledBack'|'unknown'|null, error:{code, key, params, message, detail}|null, outcomeMessage, logTail, canCancel, canRetry}|null, error:{code, key, params, message, detail}|null, rev, dryRun}: WinPoint's updater from $XDG_CACHE_HOME/win11-gnome/winpoint/ (state.json, job.json), files only in every host (D-G74a, D-G74); latest is set only while it is newer than current (the higher of this host's version and the installed payload's VERSION); a reason means no install button (noAsset, noDigest, dev and manual keep the links to the release page); job is the job of the state or null; texts rendered per call
